column_description: TEXT. Identifier linking corporate-event data to a market-condition set. PK. FK to market_conditions(REC_PIN).
TEXT. Flag indicating proximity of an upcoming corporate event. **NULL means no upcoming event recorded.**. Possible values: Earnings, M&A, Restructuring.
TEXT. Scheduled or actual announcement time of the event. Possible values: Intraday hrs before, Post-market hrs before, Pre-market hrs before.
REAL. Score estimating likelihood of information leakage before the event. Example: 34.04.
TEXT. The rate at which information leakage occurs before a corporate event's announcement, measured in score per hour. Example: 0.45 score/hour.
